title: FIPS mesh health model (Phase C.1)
intended_behavior: Workers may carry optional FIPS mesh health metrics from MMP reports as MeshHealth.
Mesh DNS projection excludes workers whose reported mesh loss is greater than 0.5.
Mesh DNS projection excludes workers whose reported mesh RTT is greater than 5 seconds.
Workers without MeshHealth data remain eligible for mesh projection when otherwise healthy.
observed_prior_behavior: Worker carried FIPS overlay address and endpoints but no mesh health metrics.
projectMeshEndpoints projected online workers with valid FIPS overlay IPv6 addresses without mesh metric gating.
